title: Arena floor
body: Rome in mid-February — NH Collection Roma Palazzo Cinquecento as the base. Colosseum on the arena floor, then a train onward later that day.

title: Palazzo del Duca
body: Late March in Matera at Palazzo del Duca Luxury Hotel — stone streets and a quiet few nights before the coast.

title: Costa Major
body: Airbnb Costa Major in Maiori for two nights. Check-in Friday afternoon. TRAVELMAR ferry along the Amalfi coast while we were there.

title: Royal Caserta
body: Evening train into Caserta and a stay at Hotel Royal Caserta. Julia on the tickets with me.

title: With an archaeologist
body: Small-group Pompeii tour at 11:30 — walking the site with someone who knew the stones. Back toward Caserta after.

title: Morning train out
body: Morning train Caserta toward Foggia. A thank-you from Royal Caserta landed around the 14th — trip winding down.
